import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', 
                       alpha=0.7, s=60, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar1.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Sleep Quality Distribution by BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
existing_bmi = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', 
            order=existing_bmi, palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Duration and Quality by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=True)

x = range(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.barh([i - width/2 for i in x], occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], 
                  width, label='Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
ax3_twin = ax3.twiny()
bars2 = ax3_twin.barh([i + width/2 for i in x], occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       width, label='Quality (1-10)', color='coral', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_yticks(x)
ax3.set_yticklabels(occupation_stats.index, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, color='steelblue')
ax3_twin.set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=10, color='coral')
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)
ax3_twin.legend(loc='lower center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder Distribution and its relation to Physical Activity
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_activity = df.groupby('Sleep Disorder').agg({
    'Physical Activity Level': 'mean',
    'Daily Steps': 'mean',
    'Person ID': 'count'
}).rename(columns={'Person ID': 'Count'})

colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c', '#3498db']
bars = ax4.bar(disorder_activity.index, disorder_activity['Physical Activity Level'], 
               color=colors[:len(disorder_activity)], alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')

# Add count labels on bars
for bar, count in zip(bars, disorder_activity['Count']):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.annotate(f'n={int(count)}',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 3),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Avg Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity Level by Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
